AI-native, free, open-source alternative to Jira, Trello, ClickUp & Monday. Built for Scrum teams where humans and AI agents collaborate as equals — on the same board, the same sprints, the same goals. Self-hosted. Fully customizable via config and plugins.

A lightweight all-in-one terminal with 20+ protocols — SSH, RDP, SFTP, databases and more. With a built-in autonomous AI Agent that plans and runs multi-turn shell commands.

Turn papers, code, and docs into presentation-ready, natively editable PPTX in Codex / Claude Code. Native charts and equations, speaker notes, click-build animations, and an independent critic review before delivery.

The token-efficient agentic coding workbench. Built for a future where every token counts — it optimizes token usage at the agent-loop level, saving 70%+ on long sessions, while planning, remembering your codebase, and shipping features in parallel from a single self-hosted binary.
